topic: Science Process Skills: Measuring, Comparing, Predicting
key_concepts: Leaf length is measured from the tip to the base along the longest part.
Leaf width is measured across the widest part from one edge to the other.
The zero mark of a ruler must align with the starting edge when measuring.
Length and width can be recorded in millimeters or centimeters.
Leaves can be compared by length to find the shortest and longest.
Leaves can be compared by width to find the narrowest and widest.
Comparing leaf size uses length and width rather than shape, color, or texture.
